title: Function coverage for WritePropertyMultiple
purpose: Cover the WritePropertyMultiple confirmed-service dispatch path with a conservative payload region that can mutate toward object, property, and value blocks.
expected_behavior: A BACnet/IP parser should dispatch this confirmed request to WritePropertyMultiple handling and expose a short write-oriented payload for downstream mutation.
constraints_preserved: Complete BVLC and NPDU framing included.
BVLC length 0x0010 matches the actual 16-byte message.
Confirmed-request APDU format includes control, invoke ID, and service choice.
Trailing payload bytes are present and bounded by the declared length.
issue_safety_notes: No issue enhancement is used. The payload is intentionally conservative and mutation-friendly.
